_note: Images for the six stages of the process and for the services, until our own photos replace them. 'ours' are drawings made by the studio (G-numbers), in English and Spanish where they carry words; the rest are Unsplash or Pexels photos (no credit required; we credit anyway). scripts/process-images.py crops each to 3:2 around 'focus' (0 top, 1 bottom) and writes site/assets/img/process/<id>[-es]-{1600,800}.webp. The alt text says what the image shows, never that it is a particular town.
